content_sections.heading: About Malappuram Collectorate
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Collector is the district administration office of Malappuram, located at the Civil Station, Malappuram-676505, Kerala. This notice was issued from its Land Acquisition (LA) section by the Deputy Collector (LA), on behalf of the District Collector, on 2 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice opens the post only to retired officers. A candidate must meet both of these conditions: Retired from a post not below the rank of Deputy Collector in the Revenue Department. Has practical experience and expertise in Land Acquisition / Arbitration matters. The notice does not mention an age limit or any educational qualification beyond these conditions. Candidates may check the official notification for the exact wording of the eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Malappuram Collectorate Administrative Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Administrative Assistant will assist the Arbitrator. The District Collector of Malappuram acts as the Arbitrator for complaints about the compensation paid to landowners for the National Highway 66 land acquisition in Malappuram district. The Administrative Assistant's role is to help settle these complaints in a time-bound manner.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Malappuram Collectorate Administrative Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare an application along with copies of the required certificates and a detailed biodata. Submit the application in person or send it by post to: Deputy Collector (LA), Collectorate, Civil Station, Malappuram - 676505. Make sure the application is submitted before 05:00 PM on 13 November 2026. Documents named in the notice: Copies of the required certificates Detailed biodata For more details, candidates can contact the Land Acquisition (LA) section of the Collectorate on 0483-2739581.
